description: This file defines the NotesQuickCreate class, which extends QuickCreate to provide functionality for quickly creating note entries in the SuiteCRM application. It primarily manages the process method that sets up the JavaScript required for the AJAX and form handling in the quick create UI.

classes.name: NotesQuickCreate
classes.description: A class extending QuickCreate to facilitate quick creation of note records within SuiteCRM. It handles form and AJAX processing, including setting up JavaScript for form validation and submission.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Sets up the environment for the quick create form, including language strings, JavaScript initialization, and AJAX handling overrides.
